lore_summary.en: Courts poets, reforms the land, defeats the Hephthalites. The golden height of the Sassanians.
lore_summary.fa: خسرو انوشیروان، ملقب به دادگر و جاودان‌روح، با سرکوب جنبش مزدکی حکومت را پایدار کرد و سپس اصلاحات گسترده‌ای در مالیات، ارتش و دیوان‌سالاری اجرا کرد. فیلسوفان یونانی را پذیرفت، شطرنج را از هند گرفت و از طریق بزرگمهر تخته‌نرد را ابداع کرد. نامش هزار سال نماد پادشاه عادل ماند.

scenes.body_en: Khosrow Anushirvan — Immortal Soul — is the king the Shahnameh holds up as proof that the ideal is achievable. Not a legend, not a myth from the distant Kayanian age, but a historical man who actually governed, who reformed the tax code and the army, who sat in judgment and was recorded as having been just. The chronicle needed him because it needed to show that the standard it had been measuring kings against could, once, be met.

His reign began with blood. The Mazdakite movement — a religious and social reform that had been spreading under his father Kavadh, demanding redistribution of wealth and the leveling of hierarchies — had to be destroyed before Anushirvan could build anything stable. He invited the Mazdakite leaders to a great assembly and had them executed. The chronicle does not flinch at this. A just king still needs order, and the Shahnameh understands that order has a cost.

What he built after that was remarkable. He fixed tax rates to land surveys rather than annual harvests, so farmers were not ruined by a single bad year. He reorganized the army into a professional force with regular pay. He reformed the court and the postal system. And he opened Iran to the world's knowledge: when the Emperor Justinian closed the Academy in Athens, Anushirvan invited the Greek philosophers to his court at Ctesiphon. He had Plato translated. He had a brahmin bring the game of chess from India, and his minister Bozorgmehr deciphered it and invented backgammon in return.

There is a story of owls that the Shahnameh uses as his founding lesson. He overheard two owls negotiating their children's marriages on a ruined rooftop. His interpreter said: each side was demanding ruined villages as dowry, and there would be no shortage under an unjust king. Anushirvan understood. He returned to court and began the reforms that would make him, a thousand years later, still the name a Persian speaker reaches for when they want to describe a ruler as genuinely good.

battle.intro_en: Khosrow Anushirvan built courts, reformed land distribution, and defeated the Hephthalites. The Shahnameh calls him Just. To face this gate you must also ask what the Just King left undone.
battle.intro_fa: خسرو انوشیروان دادگاه ساخت، توزیعِ زمین را اصلاح کرد و هیاطله را شکست داد. شاهنامه او را دادگر می‌خواند. برای مواجهه با این دروازه باید همچنین بپرسی شاهِ دادگر چه را ناتمام گذاشت.

requirements.hint_en: Scroll down to the Quiz section.

battle.intro_tg: Хусрав Ануширвон додгоҳҳо сохт, тақсими заминро ислоҳ кард ва Ҳайтолиёнро шикаст дод. Шоҳнома ӯро Одил меномад. Барои рӯбарӯ шудан бо ин дарвоза бояд ҳамчунин бипурсӣ шоҳи Одил чиро нотамом гузошт.

codex.title_fa: عدل به عنوانِ نظام، نه غریزه
codex.summary_en: Anushirvan's justice is administrative — land reform, standardized taxation, regularized courts. The Shahnameh calls him Just because his reign produced measurable fairness across a large empire for a long time, not because he had good instincts on any given day. Instinctive justice fails when the just king is tired or distracted. Systematic justice outlasts the king who built it, at least for a generation. The Shahnameh's highest praise is reserved for kings who built systems rather than kings who performed goodness personally.
codex.summary_fa: عدلِ انوشیروان اداری است. شاهنامه او را دادگر می‌خواند چون عدالتِ قابلِ اندازه‌گیری در امپراتوری‌ای بزرگ برای مدتِ طولانی تولید کرد — نه چون هر روز غریزه‌ی خوبی داشت.

codex.summary_en: Buzurgmihr is the Shahnameh's model of the wise counsellor — the figure who makes a just king more just by giving him better instruments for thinking. He answers the Indian challenge of chess with a counter-challenge of backgammon, demonstrating that Iranian intellectual culture could meet foreign riddles and generate new ones. The Shahnameh's ideal political structure is not a great king alone — it is a great king in dialogue with a great counsellor.
codex.summary_fa: بزرگمهر الگوی مشاورِ خردمندِ شاهنامه است. ساختارِ سیاسیِ ایده‌آلِ شاهنامه شاهِ بزرگ به تنهایی نیست — بلکه شاهِ بزرگ در گفتگو با مشاورِ بزرگ است.

codex.summary_en: The Hephthalites had humiliated the Sasanian empire for decades before Anushirvan — his predecessor Peroz died fighting them; his father Kavad paid tribute. Anushirvan ended this. The victory is military competence in service of political dignity, restoring the eastern frontier and demonstrating that the administrative reforms had produced an army capable of sustained campaign. The Shahnameh measures military success by what it protects, not by how spectacular it looks.
codex.summary_fa: هیاطله دهه‌ها امپراتوریِ ساسانی را تحقیر کرده بودند. انوشیروان این را پایان داد. شاهنامه پیروزیِ نظامی را با آنچه محافظت می‌کند اندازه می‌گیرد — نه با اینکه چقدر دیدنی است.

codex.title_en: What the Just King Left Undone
codex.summary_en: The Shahnameh calls Anushirvan Just and documents his achievements — then leaves visible what his justice did not reach. His son Hormuz inherited a system that collapsed within a generation. The reforms did not transfer. The chronicle notes this without editorializing. But the proximity of Anushirvan's glory to Hormuz's catastrophe is itself the editorial: justice is not a gift you can leave to heirs. It is a practice each generation must re-learn.
codex.summary_fa: انوشیروان عدالت را به عنوانِ ساختار بنا کرد اما شرایطِ بقایِ ساختار پس از مرگش را نساخت. عدالت هدیه‌ای نیست که به وارثانت بگذاری — تمرینی است که هر نسل باید دوباره یاد بگیرد.

codex.summary_en: An Indian embassy arrives with chess and a challenge: deduce the rules from observation. Buzurgmihr does, then sends back backgammon with the same challenge reversed. The episode demonstrates the court's intellectual confidence — the capacity to receive a foreign system, master it, and generate an answer. A court capable of this understands how knowledge works. Anushirvan's reign is the only Sasanian chapter where this quality is present.
codex.summary_fa: سفارتِ هندی با شطرنج می‌آید. بزرگمهر قوانین را کشف می‌کند و با نردبازی پاسخِ معکوس می‌دهد. دربارِ قادر به این کار دربارِ فاهمِ نحوه‌ی کارکردِ دانش است.

codex.title_en: The Reign That Could Not Be Inherited
codex.summary_en: Anushirvan's qualities did not transfer. Buzurgmihr is gone. The land reforms require a king who understands why they matter. Hormuz inherits the machinery but not the understanding that built it, and within thirty years the machinery becomes a weapon wielded by generals. The Shahnameh's most just king produces the chronicle's most spectacular dynastic collapse within two generations. The lesson is uncomfortable: justice built by one person cannot simply be handed to the next.
codex.summary_fa: ویژگی‌هایِ انوشیروان منتقل نشد. هرمز دستگاه را به ارث برد اما نه درکی که آن را ساخت. دادگرترین شاهِ شاهنامه در عرضِ دو نسل فروپاشیِ سلسله‌ای می‌آفریند.
